title: PrivacyNoticeDuePayload
description: Payload of the PrivacyNoticeDue platform event (class: platform; INV-REQ-1403, INV-AC-1404, INV-Q-6851 option A). evidence-svc emits it once per case when the notice to the individual falls due. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

receivedOn.description: The date the request was received.

noticeLeadDays.description: How many days before the deadline the notice falls due.
